scripts.build: npm run build:extension && npm run build:app
scripts.dev: npm run dev:extension && npm run dev:app
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.dev:x11: npm run dev:extension && npm run dev:app -- --features x11
scripts.build:extension: npm run build:extension:chrome && npm run build:extension:firefox
scripts.dev:extension: npm run dev:extension:chrome && npm run dev:extension:firefox
scripts.build:extension:chrome: npm run dev:extension:chrome && npm run pack:extension:chrome
scripts.build:extension:firefox: npm run dev:extension:firefox && npm run pack:extension:firefox && npm run pack:extension:firefox:xpi
scripts.build:flatbuffers: npm run build:flatbuffers:ws && npm run build:flatbuffers:ipc
scripts.build:flatbuffers:ws: flatc --rust -o app/backend/src/flatbuffers flatbuffers/ws_protocol.fbs && flatc --ts -o extension/src flatbuffers/ws_protocol.fbs
scripts.build:flatbuffers:ipc: flatc --rust -o app/backend/src/flatbuffers flatbuffers/ipc_protocol.fbs && flatc --ts -o app/frontend/flatbuffers flatbuffers/ipc_protocol.fbs
scripts.lint: npm run lint:extension && npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:extension && npm run typecheck:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: cd app/backend && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --tests -- -D warnings
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:extension && npm run test:backend && npm run test:api:ipc && npm run test:api:ws
scripts.format: npm run format:rust && npm run format:ts
